'''Helkson Vall''' was an individual who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a [[Sub-Prefect]] on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Kalandis IV]]. At some point, Vall recounted the tale of the [[Death/Legends|demise]] of Sub-Prefect [[Matagorn]] at the hands of the [[Srrors'tok]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Tyionsis Cex]] to [[Intel Agent 438432]] during a confidential meeting.
